what_differs: On 2026-09-23 Emily said "for phase one like just don't have it as an option" and Kobi agreed. The 09-29 Jira comment reverses this (no native setting to hide Kanban) so Kanban stays visible at go-live; the comment says Emily confirmed the deferral, but no later meeting records the client accepting a visible Kanban. The ticket is also In Progress while parented to the Phase 2 epic WAGR-478.
suggested_action: Confirm in writing with Emily that Kanban will remain visible at go-live (and whether rep onboarding should tell reps to ignore it); then move WAGR-430 out of In Progress to match its Phase 2 placement. Suggestion only.
